plan.narration_reading: The parched crucified face (#01) opens cold on 'gasped two words on a cross: I thirst'. The body-failure quote gets its literal images: the clay potsherd (#03) on 'dried up like a potsherd', the dying mouth (#04) on 'my tongue cleaveth to my jaws', the body half-sunk in dust (#05) on 'the dust of death'. The crucified Christ with cracked lips (#06) lands on John's 'I thirst'. The turn: Christ who made the waters (#08) on 'the One who made every river and spring', Jesus offering at the well (#09) on 'who offers the world living water', the empty-handed cross (#10) on 'hanging there with nothing'. The living-water finale: the kneeling drinker (#13) on 'drink and never thirst again', Moses' struck rock (#11) on 'the God who made every ocean cried out in thirst', the never-failing spring (#12) on 'the one water that never fails'. Hero #14 'That Water Is Himself' closes on 'And that water is Himself'.
plan.red_team_notes: Four water-provision clips (#09/#11/#12/#13) cluster in the climax; distinct registers (NT well / OT rock / OT spring / human drinking) keep them apart. #11 under 'cried out in thirst' is the loosest, thematic OT-echo pin.
